name: Tainai (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tainai city emblem in blue, green and orange: a blue disc bearing a green mountain, a white swoosh and an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Tainai, a city in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 September 2005.

features.role: Tainai city emblem — a blue disc bearing a green mountain, a white swoosh and an orange disc
